tasks.title: Default current-only read
tasks.prompt: Using current repo truth, answer a temporal memory question where both current and superseded historical truth exist. What should the default answer return?
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must return current truth by default and exclude superseded history unless requested.
required_facts: History can be offered as drilldown.
forbidden_claims: Historical truth is current by default.
Superseded truth should be hidden from explicit history queries.

tasks.title: Explicit history request
tasks.prompt: When a user explicitly asks for memory history, how should harness-mem surface historical/superseded truth without confusing it with current truth?
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must surface history with labels and keep current truth separate.
required_facts: Historical truth is available on explicit history paths.
Historical truth is labeled as historical or superseded.
forbidden_claims: Explicit history requests should only return current truth.

tasks.title: As-of query boundary
tasks.prompt: Can the current product answer an as_of temporal query for a past point in time? Give the safest answer from current repo truth and identify any missing product surface.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must not invent as_of behavior when product support is planning-only or incomplete.
required_facts: Uses available timestamp/version evidence if present.
States missing stable as_of product surface when relevant.
Qualifies the answer when exact as_of resolution is unavailable.
forbidden_claims: Full as_of temporal query is already benchmark-proven without evidence.
Timestamp-free history is enough for exact as_of answers.

tasks.title: Supersede timeline explanation
tasks.prompt: Given a supersede candidate or confirmed supersede test fixture, explain the old truth, new truth, and direction of replacement.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must identify old/new truth and explain supersede direction correctly.
required_facts: Old truth is marked historical or superseded.
Default reads prefer the new truth.
forbidden_claims: Old truth supersedes new truth when evidence says the opposite.
Supersede confirmation deletes all audit history.

tasks.title: Ambiguous temporal scope
tasks.prompt: A user asks 'what did we decide about this?' but the repo contains both current and historical decisions. Give the safest temporal answer and state whether clarification is needed.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must ask for scope or qualify the answer when temporal scope is ambiguous.
required_facts: Current answer is separated from historical context.
forbidden_claims: Ambiguous temporal query has one unqualified answer.
Current and historical decisions can be merged without labels.
